preregistration.legacyAssessmentEmbargo: Legacy scores, v2.1 passes, adjudications, reliability results, production critiques, tags, Overall Commentary, and AI Extensions are prohibited inputs to both v2.2 scoring passes.

executionProtocol.inventory: Copy the v2.1 locked inventory without changing burdens, sections, weights, move selection, importance, or source spans; add only v2.2 provenance and audio-verification metadata.
executionProtocol.audioVerification: Every medium- or low-confidence move must have a successful local audio-verification artifact and hash before either pass begins.
executionProtocol.passA: A fresh isolated 5.6 Sol task scores the locked inventory using only the explicit v2.2 allowlist.
executionProtocol.passB: A different fresh isolated 5.6 Sol task scores the identical inventory without Pass A or v2.1 scoring material.
executionProtocol.adjudication: A fresh task compares only schema-valid Pass A and Pass B outputs and adjudicates threshold-triggered differences under v2.2.
executionProtocol.productionIsolation: All artifacts remain under docs/calibration/v2.2/complete-gate and never update production debates, ledgers, or rankings.

hardGates.scoringPassIsolation: separate model tasks with explicit file allowlists and no score or rationale leakage

readinessRule.initialGate: Every hard gate must pass; review exceptions require documented evidence-based adjudication.
readinessRule.expandedGate: A pass authorizes only a preregistered ten-complete-debate v2.2 gate.
readinessRule.corpusWide: All 195 debates remain unauthorized until the ten-debate gate passes and the editor explicitly approves promotion.
